en: So if you wanna build an agent, you can use
a broad variety of libraries and frameworks
to make your life easier. And some of the
options worth knowing, and by far not all of
them,
are the ones you see on this slide. Popular
choices are, for example, the Vercel AI SDK
if you're working with TypeScript.
LangGraph is very popular for Python and
TypeScript. Pydantic AI is of course worth
mentioning. Crew AI is popular and, well,
most of them or pretty much All of them here
are popular. And as mentioned, there are
more. In this section, we'll dive into 2
example frameworks that could be used for
building agents. CrewAI for building agents
with Python and the EVE framework, which is
my personal favorite. But again, you can
explore all these options here for your next
project if you do plan on building agents
yourself.
